title: fix(app-shell): never render a foreign app for an unresolved /apps/:name (preview wrong-app fix)
body:
## Problem

After building + publishing a new app, navigating to `/apps/<newapp>` — notably the **in-chat Live Canvas preview iframe** (published/materialized mode) — rendered a **different, pre-existing app's content** during the brief window where the metadata registry hadn't caught up. The URL was correct but the rendered app/object was wrong, e.g. `/apps/asset_management/<ticket object>` showing the ticket app. Opening the URL after the registry settled worked fine. This directly undermines the "build an app → see it" magic moment.

## Root cause

`AppContent` resolved the active app as:

```ts
matchAppBySegment(apps, appName) || launcherApps.find(isDefault) || launcherApps[0]
```

When the requested `appName` wasn't in the freshly-loaded `apps` yet (post-publish lag), it **fell back to a different app**, and the URL's `:objectName` then rendered against that foreign app. Draft-preview mode already guarded this (`PreviewDraftEmptyState`); **published mode did not**.

## Fix

- Only fall back to a default app when **no specific app** was requested (bare `/apps`, the default redirect) or for the built-in pseudo-routes (`create-app` / `system` / `metadata` / `setup`).
- For a normal unmatched `appName`: never render a foreign app. **Re-check metadata once** (covers the post-publish lag, so a just-built app resolves on its own), then show an **"App not available"** state.

## Verification (in-browser, objectos-ee + console dev)

- `/apps/<nonexistent>` → "App not available" with Retry — **no foreign app** rendered (URL stays put). 
- `/apps/ticket_service_app` → renders the ticket app (no regression).
- `/apps/setup` → keeps its default-app fallback (no regression; it's a pseudo-route, not a metadata app).

AppContent is a large integration component with no existing unit test; verification is browser-based.
